<!-- No-op chainable $ shim: this public page has no jQuery, but the form widgets emit
             $(...).select2()/.validate()/.tooltip(). Without this they throw "Can't find variable: $".
             Drop-downs fall back to native <select> (better on mobile); server still validates. -->
        <script>(function(){if(window.jQuery)return;function api(){return o;}var o={};['select2','validate','tooltip','parents','removeClass','addClass','on','off','ready','each','val','attr','prop','find','closest','submit','click','change'].forEach(function(m){o[m]=api;});var f=function(){return o;};f.fn=o;window.$=window.jQuery=f;})();</script>
        <!-- Moqui renders the form <fieldset> disabled and re-enables it via its jQuery bundle; this page has
             no jQuery, so enable it here or every field is un-editable and excluded from submit (see /signup). -->
        <script>(function(){function en(){var fs=document.querySelectorAll('fieldset[disabled]');for(var i=0;i<fs.length;i++)fs[i].removeAttribute('disabled');}if(document.readyState!=='loading')en();else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',en);})();</script>
        <!-- ZE-AUTH-014 / ONB-010: real-time Workspace-URL (subdomain) availability. Debounced GET to the
             checkSubdomain transition (validate#Subdomain) shows Available / taken / invalid under the field.
             Advisory only — provision#Tenant re-validates on submit, so a race can never create a duplicate. -->
        <script>(function(){
          function init(){
            var inp=document.querySelector('input[name=subdomain]'); if(!inp) return;
            var msg=document.createElement('div'); msg.id='subdomain-availability'; msg.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');
            msg.style.cssText='font-size:12.5px;margin:6px 0 0;line-height:1.45;min-height:16px;font-weight:600';
            (inp.closest('.form-group')||inp.parentNode).appendChild(msg);
            var t, lastQ='';
            function show(txt,color){ msg.textContent=txt; msg.style.color=color; }
            function check(){
              var v=(inp.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
              if(!v){ show('',''); lastQ=''; return; }
              if(v===lastQ) return; lastQ=v;
              show('Checking availability…','#949bab');
              var url=location.pathname.replace(/\/$/,'')+'/checkSubdomain?sub='+encodeURIComponent(v);
              fetch(url,{credentials:'same-origin',headers:{'Accept':'application/json'}})
                .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
                .then(function(d){
                  if((inp.value||'').trim().toLowerCase()!==v) return; // stale — user kept typing
                  if(d&&d.available){ show('✓ '+(d.canonical||v)+'.zetaclantech.com is available','#1c8a4a'); }
                  else{ show('✗ '+((d&&d.reason)?d.reason:'Not available'),'#c62828'); }
                })
                .catch(function(){ if((inp.value||'').trim().toLowerCase()===v) show('Could not check availability right now.','#949bab'); });
            }
            inp.addEventListener('input',function(){ clearTimeout(t); t=setTimeout(check,450); });
            inp.addEventListener('blur',function(){ clearTimeout(t); check(); });
          }
          if(document.readyState!=='loading') init(); else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);
        })();</script>
        <style>
        .Onboarding{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f6f8fc 0%,#e9edf7 100%);min-height:100vh;}
        .Onboarding .zonb-page{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;padding:44px 16px 72px;}
        .Onboarding .zonb-card{width:100%;max-width:580px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e9ebf2;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 12px 44px rgba(28,37,68,.10);padding:38px 42px;}
        .Onboarding .zonb-brand{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7C3AED;margin-bottom:20px;}
        .Onboarding h4{font-size:27px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:800;color:#1b2238;margin:0 0 7px;letter-spacing:-.015em;}
        .Onboarding .zonb-sub{display:block;color:#69707f;font-size:15px;margin:0 0 22px;line-height:1.5;}
        .Onboarding .zonb-alert{border-radius:10px;padding:11px 14px;margin:0 0 16px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:600;}
        .Onboarding .zonb-alert-error{background:#fdecef;border:1px solid #f5b5c0;border-left:4px solid #c62828;color:#8a1220;}
        .Onboarding .zonb-alert-ok{background:#e8f6ec;border:1px solid #b7e2c4;border-left:4px solid #1c8a4a;color:#155e34;}
        .Onboarding h6{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7C3AED;margin:28px 0 14px;padding-bottom:9px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef0f6;}
        .Onboarding .form-horizontal .form-group{margin:0 0 17px;display:block;}
        .Onboarding .form-horizontal .control-label{display:block;float:none;width:auto;text-align:left;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#3b4254;margin:0 0 6px;padding:0;}
        .Onboarding .form-horizontal .col-sm-2,.Onboarding .form-horizontal .col-sm-10{display:block;float:none;width:100%;padding:0;}
        .Onboarding .form-control{width:100%;height:auto;padding:11px 13px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.3;color:#1b2238;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d5dae4;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:none;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;}
        .Onboarding .form-control:focus{border-color:#7C3AED;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(110, 86, 207,.16);outline:none;}
        .Onboarding select.form-control{height:44px;}
        .Onboarding .form-group p,.Onboarding .text-caption{font-size:12.5px;color:#949bab;margin:6px 0 0;line-height:1.45;}
        .Onboarding .btn,.Onboarding button[type=submit],.Onboarding input[type=submit]{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:10px;background:#7C3AED;border:none;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:15.5px;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:11px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(110, 86, 207,.26);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,transform .04s,box-shadow .15s;}
        .Onboarding .btn:hover,.Onboarding button[type=submit]:hover{background:#6D28D9;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(110, 86, 207,.32);}
        .Onboarding .btn:active{transform:translateY(1px);}
        .Onboarding .zonb-trust{text-align:center;color:#9098a8;font-size:12.5px;margin-top:14px;}
        .Onboarding .zonb-foot{text-align:center;margin-top:22px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #eef0f6;color:#69707f;font-size:14px;}
        .Onboarding .zonb-foot a{color:#7C3AED;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;}
        .Onboarding .zonb-foot a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
        @media (max-width:560px){.Onboarding .zonb-card{padding:28px 22px;border-radius:14px;}.Onboarding h4{font-size:23px;}}
        </style>
